title: Easy Malaysian Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and delicious stir fry dish from Malaysia, made with tender chicken, silky noodles, and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the noodles to the pan and cook according to the package instructions.
Return the chicken to the pan and stir in the soy sauce, chili flakes, salt, and pepper.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is coated in the sauce.
Serve the chicken and noodles hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
